data.body: fix-bug:investigation complete. VERDICT: STALE (b410740224, 2026-06-01). Root cause: pre-b410740224 _extract_json_from_text returned None for trailing-comma fenced JSON (e.g. {"findings":[],"summary":"x",} inside code fences); dispatch._parse_response then emitted the 'non-JSON response' error and triggered the blocking-findings fallback. Fix: b410740224 added trailing-comma self-heal. All parse sites: (1) dispatch.py:447 _parse_response - COMPLETE; (2) providers/anthropic.py:73 - COMPLETE (R5); (3) providers/openai.py:68 - MISSING rescue (legacy adapter, not CI path); (4) aggregator.py:126 - partial ({..} slice). Residual gap: providers/openai.py. Red test: add TestR5OpenAIProviderRescue class in test_bug_f148_recurrence_prevention.py using markdown-fenced.txt fixture + new markdown-fenced-empty-findings.txt fixture. See scratch key fix-bug:investigation for full details.
